quotes.text: My dear brothers and sisters, my message is for everyone whose heart aches for loved ones who have turned away from the Lord, stepped away from obedience to Godâs laws, breached their covenants, and left behind a string of broken hearts, becoming, as the Bible says, âtossed to and fro.â

quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: In our grief, we continuously ponder the whys, hows, and what ifs. We feel we have failed. We spend sleepless nights going over how we tried to draw our loved ones close to Jesus Christ and the Spirit. We preach, cajole, argue, demand, lecture, ignore, sit them down to watch general conference, and even send them links to the talks, like this one, but to no avail. If anything, these efforts can cause a greater rift.
quotes.speaker: Elder RonaldÂ A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Listen carefully. I ask you to turn over to Jesus Christ your despair for those wayward souls. We cannot change their hearts, but He can; He is a God of miracles. We love our family members and friends profoundly, but they are foremost children of our Father in Heaven, who knows and loves them even more than we do. Our Father, the great Elohim, gave His Beloved Son the authority and power necessary to heal all His children. That is the good news of the gospel. By the power of Jesus Christâs Atonement, there is always a way back!
quotes.speaker: Elder RonaldÂ A. Rasband
quotes.session: Saturday Morning Session, October 2026 General Conference

quotes.text: Love is not stepping back or sanctioning othersâ decisions and actions. Love is being interested in their lives, their successes, and their challenges. Love is being there with arms outstretched and a cheerful countenance. Love is lifting with faith and hope in our Lord and Savior. Love relies upon the calming influence of the Holy Ghost. The book of Proverbs teaches, âTrust in the Lord with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understandingÂ â¦Â, and he [will] direct thy paths.â The path is marked by love.

quotes.text: For three long days and nights, young Alma âwas racked with eternal torment.â Somewhere deep within came his fatherâs teachings of the coming of Jesus Christ âto atone for the sins of the world.â Alma cried in his heart, âO Jesus, thou Son of God, have mercy on me.â The love of the Savior filled him âwith joy.â He became a mighty prophet and a major figure in the Book of Mormon.

quotes.text: Brothers and sisters, Jesus Christ pulls more than His weight. His Atonement is witness of His all-encompassing love for each one of us. Brutal as it was for Him, His Atonement was crucial for our eternal journey. Remember, âGreater love hath no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.â

quotes.text: What brought him back? It was love. He knew where to find it. Love, brothers and sisters, is the answer to connecting with all of our loved ones. Our Father extends His protective arms to us and to those still distant from Him and His Son. He asks us to do the same. Jesus Christ beckons, âCome unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest.â

quotes.text: Third, remember Jesus Christ is the answer. He is, always has been, and always will be. Seek Him through study of the scriptures and words of prophets, apostles, men and women leaders who are devoted to serving the Lord. And pray. Pray mightily to our Heavenly Father in the name of Jesus Christ. He will not leave us âcomfortless.â
